narration:0:1013001001:1.text: The ship heading back to Holistone set sail.

say:3:1013001003:1.text: Watching those refugees find shelter, it feels like things in the Dark Forest are finally settling down.
say:3:1013001003:1.source_cn: 看着那些难民得到安置，事到如今，薄暮丛林的事态算是告一...

say:5:1013001004:1.text: *Laughter* We're just like the tales sung by the bards—loyal knights, once again wielding their swords and shields, protecting the people!
say:5:1013001004:1.source_cn: 嗯嗯！就像吟游诗人唱的那样——忠义的骑士满满，再一次用...

say:7:1013001005:2.text: Come on, you big talker. You didn't even do much.
say:7:1013001005:2.source_cn: 满满这个笨蛋，明明什么也没做嘛。

say:8:1013001006:2.text: Our mighty magister did most of the work, right?
say:8:1013001006:2.source_cn: 解除限制令、救助难民，主要都是梅林大人的功劳，是吧是吧！
say:8:1013001006:2.male: Our mighty magister did most of the work, right?
say:8:1013001006:2.female: Our mighty magister did most of the work, right?

choice_prompt:9:1013001006.text: Our mighty magister did most of the work, right?
choice_prompt:9:1013001006.source_cn: 解除限制令、救助难民，主要都是梅林大人的功劳，是吧是吧！
choice_prompt:9:1013001006.male: Our mighty magister did most of the work, right?
choice_prompt:9:1013001006.female: Our mighty magister did most of the work, right?

say:10:1013001007:2.source_cn: 哈，你这幅充满魅力的嘴脸真可恶。

say:11:1013001008:2.text: Anyways, we're back in Holistone again. I wonder if anyone missed me?
say:11:1013001008:2.source_cn: 再度归来，圣石镇的居民们，应该没有特别想念我吧？

choice:9:0:1.text: I just did what I could.
choice:9:0:1.male: I just did what I could.
choice:9:0:1.female: I just did what I could.

choice:9:1:2.text: Couldn't have done it without you all.
choice:9:1:2.male: Couldn't have done it without you all.
choice:9:1:2.female: Couldn't have done it without you all.
